firstMigration: Associate existing saves with per-world UUIDs and preserve/adopt existing waypoint data once; do not delete historical points.
onlyRuntimeScope: Singleplayer waypoint generation ownership; retain displaced waypoint sets under local/lanmc-waypoint-archives/v1 and restore matching generations.
nativeMapResolver: FileHandler.getJMWorldDirForWorldId(Minecraft,String), with guarded missing/existing ancestor validation before any policy directory creation.
nativeSavesAnchor: Minecraft.getInstance().getLevelSource().getBaseDir(), lexical game/saves only; pin its canonical target once and reject child aliases/retargets.
limits: Only one active client per game directory; external concurrent edits are unsupported.
Already-contaminated legacy waypoint data cannot be attributed to world generations safely and is preserved during first migration.
Native deferred deathpoint creation sleeps at least three seconds and does not capture world generation; that separate native race is not changed by this association policy.
No real Minecraft startup, NeoForge event-bus delivery, rendering or world visibility acceptance is claimed by the artifact-only native tests.
This is rollback/process-interruption recovery, not a hardware/power-loss fsync guarantee.
